inventory.evidence_locator: AEMO NEM Generation Information July 2026 workbook, Generator Information sheet, independently inventoried with openpyxl for NSW1/QLD1/VIC1 and source-native composite row identity.
inventory.notes: Independent inventory is assurance/inventories/aemo_generation_information_july_2026_unit_ids.json. Gen Info Unit ID alone is not unique in the published sheet, so identity uses Gen Info Unit ID + Survey ID + Unit Name + DUID + Technology Type + Technology Detail.

checks.result: 1415 expected records and 1415 extracted records; zero missing, zero extra and zero duplicate composite source_record_ids.

checks.method: Spot-check source rows and preserve AEMO Commitment Status, technology, AC/DC generation capacity and storage MWh as separate fields without VECA reclassification.
checks.evidence_locator: AEMO Generator Information sheet and Background Information field definitions; derived CSV retains all 165 source columns.

notes: Exhaustive source-observation layer for QLD1/NSW1/VIC1. ACT projects appear within NSW1 where AEMO assigns them to the NSW NEM region. This dataset is not yet a map-ready site layer: site-level grouping and geometry/location joins should derive from Survey ID/KCI/site identity without losing unit-level evidence.
